name: wordoria-crystal-quest
description: Wordoria Crystal Quest hybrid Android game

scripts.build: npm run build:content && npm run build:native && npm run build:auth && npm run build:creator && node scripts/build-web.mjs
scripts.build:creator: esbuild map-creator-entry.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=map-creator.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
